He also explained why he keeps asking to play on Louis Armstrong Stadium: no suites, and a crowd that watches the tennis.

items.title: “They’re starting to embrace me” – Tsitsipas reaches a first US Open fourth round
items.summary: Stefanos Tsitsipas says he has never had support like this in New York, and he had never reached the second week here either. The Greek, ranked No. 53, beat No. 18 seed Jiri Lehecka 2-6, 6-1, 7-6 (3), 6-1, then offered to hand a credential to every fan who had cheered for him.

items.title: Alcaraz, Sabalenka get clear on the calendar issues: they call for mandatory tournament cuts
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz says he will start missing tournaments because playing every mandatory event would mean 40 weeks of tennis a year. Two days later Aryna Sabalenka went further, asking the WTA and ATP to scrap the mandatory events altogether. If they do not, the World No. 1 said, players will simply pay the price themselves: "We'll have to sacrifice points, ranking position, whatever."
